qualifications.text: Crane and hoisting priced at two picks.
Roof drains and overflow drains, metal wall panels, and curbs excluded (outside 07A).

evidence.quote: Furnish and install self-adhered vapor retarder over the metal deck, tapered polyisocyanurate insulation to R-30 average with crickets to drains per A-401 as revised by Addendum 1, 1/2" gypsum cover board, and 60-mil TPO membrane, fully adhered, per Section 07 54 23. Flash all mechanical curbs and pipe penetrations furnished by others. Walkway pads at rooftop units and at the hatch per A-401.
Shop-fabricated coping, edge metal, and counterflashing per Section 07 62 00, 24 ga. prefinished, color per architect.
Crane and hoisting of our materials included, two picks. Perimeter warning line and fall protection for our crew included. Twenty-year manufacturer NDL system warranty included.
Roof hatch by others. Roof drains and overflow drains NIC. Metal wall panels NIC. Curbs by others.
Alternate No. 1, 80-mil TPO membrane in lieu of 60-mil: ADD $21,300.00.
Additional tapered insulation, furnished and installed: $6.75 per SF.
Base bid $612,400.00. Sales tax included. Performance and payment bond not included; add 1.5% if required. Proposal valid 45 days from August 25, 2026.
